item.title: Kyuukon Saimin ~Watashi, Zettai ni Uwaki Nante Shimasen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: include
  • 発売日: 2020-06-26
  • スコア: 6.609999999999999/10 (80 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 求婚催眠 ～私、絶対に浮気なんてしません～
  • 英語名: Kyuukon Saimin Watashi, Zettai ni Uwaki Nante Shimasen

别名

  • 求婚催○

あらすじ

The protagonist, Hachiyama Saisei, was a man who had clawed his way up from the very bottom. He let nothing stand in his way, using deception, threats, and hypnotic techniques as needed to expand his company.

His next target was the Sakuragaoka Group. After infiltrating one of their parties, Saisei found himself utterly captivated by the beauty of Sakuragaoka Rei - a woman young enough to be his daughter. He was already scheming to absorb the Sakuragaoka Group and grow his own enterprise even further. From his perspective, a politically arranged marriage with Reisen was the optimal choice, satisfying both his ambitions and his desires.

item.title: Saimin Iinchou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: include
  • 発売日: 2016-08-26
  • スコア: 6.92/10 (45 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 催眠委員長
  • 英語名: Saimin Iinchou

あらすじ

After much effort, the protagonist, Sumoto Hikari, enters Rinsho Academy, a prestigious school known throughout the country. However, his joy ends there. Everyone around him is even better than him, even though he was supposed to be “excellent.” Little by little, Hikari falls behind. Then, he is told about a good study method: “self-hypnosis.”

After researching it more, he realizes that it can be used on others, and releases the frustration that has been building up inside him. After using it on many girls, Hikari’s final target is the student council president, Kubota Asahi, who is known as a genius even within the school, and the chairperson of the discipline committee, Arisawa Fumika, who has a grudge against Hikari and always scolds him.

item.title: Brave Hunter Aoi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: include
  • 発売日: 2015-04-30
  • スコア: 6.8/10 (31 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ブレイブハンターあおい
  • 英語名: Brave Hunter Aoi

あらすじ

One day, they suddenly appeared out of nowhere. They dominate humans with violence, wielding inhuman power, and are growing into a massive structure. They are an evil organization called Nemesis.

Its influence gradually spread, and people began to live their lives, shuddering in fear. However, as if in accord with Nemesis, allies of justice also appeared and turned into a resistance force, obstructing its uprising. The girls simply keep fighting with the organization to help the people without ever revealing their identities.
